# Looking for Group

## October 15, 2024 @ 6:00 pm - 9:00 pm

*   [« Lorcana Ink League](https://pdknine.com/event/lorcana-ink-league-2/)
*   [MTG: Two-Headed Giant Tournament »](https://pdknine.com/event/mtg-two-headed-giant-tournament/)

Looking for people to play games with? Whether you’re flying solo or coming with friends, our **Looking for Group** event is the perfect chance to meet new gamers, play board games, and make connections for future game nights! We’ll have tables reserved with special “Looking for Group” signs, so just grab a seat, introduce yourself, and jump into a game. With [over 500 games in our library](https://boardgamegeek.com/collection/user/pdkNINE?objecttype=thing&ff=1&subtype=boardgame), there’s something for everyone—whether you’re into strategy, party games, or something in between.

Come for the games, stay for the community! No registration required—just show up and join the fun!
